title: The Derelict Quarantine
logline: A derelict ship drifts into the system carrying survivors of a plague, and a doctor races to cure them while enforcers try to destroy the vessel.

roles.description: Driven, exhausted, refusing to give up on patients.
Cold, sees the derelict as an unacceptable risk.
A massive, dark generational colony ship.
A militant group enforcing strict quarantine laws.
The command vessel of the blockade.

public_situation: A derelict colony ship has drifted into scanning range, broadcasting an ancient plague warning.
private_truth: The doctor believes they have synthesized a cure, but the enforcers have already been paid to destroy the ship.

beats.public_change: The enforcers set up a perimeter around the derelict.

missions.reason: Needs rare biological stabilizers delivered immediately to complete the cure.
missions.private_fact: The doctor is currently aboard the derelict and has contracted the plague themselves.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to scan the ship's outer hull to map a safe route past the enforcers.
missions.private_fact: The enforcers are already laying proximity mines. This is a closely guarded secret they refuse to share.

beats.public_change: The enforcers announce their intention to fire on the derelict.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to destroy the enforcer blockade ships to buy time for the cure to take effect.
missions.private_fact: The cure is working, but the patients are too weak to survive a hull breach.

beats.public_change: The doctor successfully cures the first patient.

missions.reason: The enforcer captain hails the pilot, offering them a massive bounty to destroy the derelict's engines.
missions.private_fact: The enforcers are terrified the plague will spread to their home system.

beats.public_change: The derelict's engines finally sputter to life.

missions.reason: Needs the cured patients evacuated to a medical frigate before the enforcers regroup.
missions.private_fact: The doctor will stay behind to ensure the rest of the ship is scuttled safely.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot must choose the fate of the survivors.

resolutions.summary: The survivors are brought to safety and the plague is cured. The enforcers face public backlash.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the missions or fails to break the blockade.
resolutions.summary: The derelict is destroyed with everyone aboard. The enforcers claim they saved the system.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the engines for the enforcers.
resolutions.summary: The derelict is stranded in deep space. The patients are cured but trapped forever.

loose_threads.detail: The plague's genetic markers indicate it was engineered in a high-security corporate biolab.
The enforcers are receiving hazard pay from a rival colonization company.

radio_hooks: Quarantine zone established around unknown derelict.
Medical experts urge caution as ancient plague fears spread.

voice_direction.ruthless_enforcer: Harsh, unyielding, speaks like a zealot.
